meta.title: Why the quietest room on Earth will drive you insane in 45 minutes #shorts
meta.description:
Have you ever wanted absolute peace and quiet? Be careful what you wish for. Deep inside Minneapolis, there’s a room so silent, it holds the Guinness World Record. It’s an anechoic chamber, absorbing ninety-nine point nine percent of all sound. When you step inside and the heavy door shuts, the silence becomes instantly deafening. Within minutes, your ears adapt, and you start hearing things you were never meant to hear. You will hear your own lungs breathing, the blood pumping through your veins, and your bones grinding together. Without external sounds to guide you, you quickly lose your balance and begin to hallucinate. The longest anyone has ever lasted inside is just forty-five minutes. Do you think you could survive an hour in here, or would you lose your mind? Tell us in the comments!
